reason: Claim c1 (in_scope) is confirmed by runtime probe t7: comparing the Triton kernel's run(x) output against the contract reference (a direct modular DFT evaluating out[b,k] = sum_j x[b,j]*omega_N^(j*k) mod 3329 exactly as the problem statement specifies) across N=64 and N=128, batches 1/7/128, seeds 0/1/2/123, plus all-zero and all-max constant rows, produced 104991 mismatched elements out of ~105096 tested — every random and constant-nonzero row failed on nearly all elements (e.g. N64_B1_s0: 64 of 64 mismatched; N128_B128_s0: 16378 of 16384). Only all-zero rows matched. The contract mandates exact equality with absolute and relative tolerance 0 for every canonical input, so this is a hard violation; the kernel's fused butterfly/twiddle computation does not compute the required cyclic NTT.
